_comment: Copy to the cluster/backend repo root as .mcp.json. Needs docker, kubectl and helm on PATH. Kubernetes server starts read-only; add --disable-destructive=false only on a dev cluster.

grafana._comment: Self-hosted Grafana. For Grafana Cloud use { "type": "http", "url": "https://mcp.grafana.com/mcp" } instead.

docs-rs._comment: Rust crate docs for the Rust services. Context7 covers npm; it is weak on crates.
